 Your Weekly Horoscopes by Madame Clairevoyant: October 25-31
 By 
 Claire Comstock-Gay ,
 astrologer and Cut columnist.   
 She has written weekly horoscopes for more than ten years and is the author of 'Madame Clairevoyant’s Guide to the Stars.' 
 5:00 A.M. 
 Every Sunday, Claire Comstock-Gay reads the stars as Madame Clairevoyant and shares the weekly horoscope for each zodiac sign.
 Save this article to read it later.
 Find this story in your account’s ‘Saved for Later’ section.
 Every Sunday, Claire Comstock-Gay reads the stars as Madame Clairevoyant and shares the weekly horoscope for each zodiac sign.
 Photo-Illustration: by The Cut; Photo: Getty Images 
 Early Sunday morning, Venus retrograde moves backward from Scorpio into Libra . For the remaining three weeks of this retrograde, take a beat to reflect on where your relationships have felt unfair, not fully reciprocal. It’s time to stop making excuses and start being honest about any imbalances. But don’t initiate any confrontations just yet, if you can help it! It’s enough, for now, to identify the problems and come up with a plan to address them. Plus, late Sunday night, the Taurus full moon could bring practical issues to the forefront anyway. Even if you’d prefer to devote your energy to less mundane matters, you might not have a choice. And if you deal with the tangible problems first, you may find that your abstract dilemmas become clearer in the process. In the meantime, find the weekly horoscope for each zodiac sign, below.
 Aries Weekly Horoscope
 You sometimes feel like you have a responsibility to set your ambitions as high as possible. If you think you can achieve something great, you have an obligation to go for it; holding back would be a waste of your talents, maybe even a sign of laziness. But this week, remember that your own desires matter, too. If you’re genuinely satisfied with more modest outcomes, and you don’t particularly want to climb higher and higher, then there’s no reason to push yourself. Decide what kind of life would make you happy, and don’t make it more complicated than that.
 Taurus Weekly Horoscope
 There are plenty of situations where you don’t want to express yourself too openly. Maybe you know that your opinion is an unpopular one, and you’re not in the mood for an argument; maybe you simply don’t think your personal feelings are relevant to whatever else is going on. But the more you’ve been holding back lately, the more you’ll need to vent now . The longer you silence yourself, the more the pressure inside you builds, so try to find a healthy outlet for all your unexpressed feelings this week.
 Gemini Weekly Horoscope
 This week, there might be more demands on your time than usual; everyone seems to need something from you, and you could easily fill every moment of every day with activity. But right now, it’s more important than ever that you carve out some alone time. You need opportunities to reset, recharge, and do nothing — and if you don’t get them, you’ll quickly get prickly and stressed. Prioritize getting the peace and quiet you need, even if that means canceling plans or disappointing other people.
 Cancer Weekly Horoscope
 This week, your friends — especially the ones who are usually the most independent — might seem more needy than usual. They all have problems they want your help with, and they insist that there’s no time to waste. Your first reaction might be surprise, and even a bit of irritation: You have issues of your own to worry about, and you know that your friends are capable enough to manage by themselves. But try to be generous. If you prioritize being a good friend right now, you’ll be rewarded with deeper relationships and a stronger support system.
 Leo Weekly Horoscope
 Although you sometimes get an urge to show off, you try not to give in to it all the time. You know that nobody responds well to arrogance, so you do your best not to let your ego get carried away. Every so often, though, a bit of self-promotion can be helpful, even necessary. This week, especially, make a point of putting your best foot forward and showing the people around you what you’re capable of. Too much humility will only get you ignored; if you want opportunities to come your way, then make a point of demonstrating your skills.
 Virgo Weekly Horoscope
 This probably isn’t the best week to take random, spur-of-the-moment risks: You’ll benefit from giving yourself more time to think things over, first. However, it could be an ideal time for taking chances that you’ve already been considering for a long time. Maybe you’ve wanted to do something totally new, but were scared to take the plunge; maybe your cautious side keeps talking you out of it at the last minute. This week, stop overthinking and letting your fear get the better of you; just go for it.
 Libra Weekly Horoscope
 You do your best to be patient with everyone you interact with, even when they’re being irritating or thoughtless. You know that people are often dealing with problems you aren’t aware of, so you try to err on the side of kindness and generosity. But everyone has limits to what they’re willing to tolerate, and this week, you might finally hit yours. Don’t tell yourself that you “should” put up with endless frustrations: At a certain point, it becomes time either to push back or walk away.
 Scorpio Weekly Horoscope
 You’re good enough at reading people that you don’t always need them to make their needs explicit: You can generally intuit what they’re feeling, even if they don’t say anything. The trouble is that you often assume that others are equally good at reading your mind — and then you get frustrated when they aren’t. This week, give your friends a fair shot by being clear about what you want from them. Being secretive about your expectations only sets them up to fail, so put it all out in the open.
 Sagittarius Weekly Horoscope
 If you feel dissatisfied with your life, this week you’ll probably imagine that you need to take big, decisive actions to address the problem. You may tell yourself that the only solution is to quit your job, or leave your relationship, or move across the country — but chances are, drastic moves aren’t going to address the underlying issue right now. Your best bet is to focus on small, sustainable actions instead: The answer lies in your routines and your everyday life, not in some grand, dramatic gesture.
 Capricorn Weekly Horoscope
 You have a creative, fun-loving side, but you don’t always let it out. You tell yourself that one day, once you’ve achieved enough tangible success, you can start enjoying yourself — but until then, you have to keep grinding. But that mind-set will only make you miserable, because there’s always more work to be done and you’ll never be truly convinced that you’ve done “enough.” Don’t push all the good parts of life into some faraway future — if you’re going to have any fun, you’ve got to find a way to fit it into your life now .
 Aquarius Weekly Horoscope
 When you’re busy at work or focused on issues out in your community, it’s easy to neglect issues closer to home. It’s nothing to be ashamed of — you only have so much to give, and sometimes you have to prioritize. But this week, any problems you’ve been overlooking could come to a head now. Try not to get prickly or defensive or to beat yourself up for not managing to do it all perfectly. Just put a bit of extra time and attention into fixing whatever is wrong.
 Pisces Weekly Horoscope
 You probably have a tendency to put off the tasks that seem tedious. It’s just that there’s always enough genuinely interesting work to do that it’s hard to find the motivation for the dull stuff, right? Eventually, though, procrastination will catch up to you — so this week, do your best to buckle down and take care of small tasks as they come up. You might not find it particularly rewarding, but see it as a favor for your future self. Everything will be easier later on if you take care of your to-do list now.
